definitions.admission: Current causal feature_available and frozen base candidate floor only; unknown future labels do not exclude alerts.
definitions.alert: Inclusive score>=numeric threshold, calibrated once on CAL candidates without labels and frozen on TEST.
definitions.precision: Correct frozen chosen side / all known alerts; BOTH counts correct for either chosen side.
definitions.safe_precision: Correct chosen side and cost2 pre-cross safety / all known alerts. Unknown risk is not counted safe.
definitions.none_fpr: NONE alerts / all admitted known NONE roots, not merely candidate NONE roots.
definitions.event_opportunity_recall: Correct chosen-side alerts / all admitted known roots with any event (LONG, SHORT, BOTH).
definitions.safe_recall: Safe correct alerts / all admitted known roots whose frozen chosen side is correct and risk-known safe.
definitions.economics: Existing continuous one-position account; USD/reference ounce after stated fee/latency. Signals are not trades.
definitions.censor: Partial daily cash/trades are null as complete outcomes. Any incomplete full TEST account suppresses its paired economic interval.
definitions.pairing: Arm-minus-base within each seed/date (base-minus-arm for NONE FPR); then equal seed average inside date; then equal-weight whole-date resampling.
definitions.inference: Descriptive percentile interval from 20000 whole-date bootstrap draws. Only five TEST dates; dates need not be independent. Seeds are not extra days. No multiple-comparison correction.
definitions.trade_sign: Positive trade-count difference is more activity, not a quality improvement.
definitions.selector: Primary setting is separate from the CAL economic selector. No TEST winner or threshold is selected.
definitions.historical_scope: Dates are new relative to V3/V4 but not claimed never inspected historically; base GCQ6 versus new GCZ6 conflates temporal and contract changes.
